judgments.reason: The span 'Sinus rhythm with right bundle-branch block' appears literally in both ECG descriptions and clinically supports the right bundle-branch block component of alternating fascicular block (bifascicular block alternating between RBBB+LAFB and RBBB+LPFB).
The span 'Left anterior fascicular block' appears literally in the first ECG findings and clinically supports the alternating fascicular block diagnosis, as the first ECG shows RBBB with LAFB.

The span 'Left posterior fascicular block' appears literally in the second ECG findings and clinically supports the alternating fascicular block diagnosis, as the second ECG shows RBBB with LPFB, confirming alternation between the two fascicles.
